narrative.headline: Semiconductor and computer hardware flow dominates with concentrated bullish premium, but cracks emerge in AMD and memory/equipment names.
bullish_themes: Heavy bullish positioning across mega-cap semis (NVDA, INTC, MRVL) with $70M+ combined premium and 86%+ ask-side bullish skew
Broad bid in semiconductor equipment and electronic components (KLAC, AMAT, FLEX, GLW, VICR, TTMI) suggesting capex/supply-chain conviction
Computer hardware AI-adjacent names lighting up (IONQ, SMCI, DELL, SNDK) with strong directional ask-side flow
Flow is overwhelmingly concentrated in XLK — XLF, XLI barely register
notable_individual_flows: NVDA: $35M premium, 86% bullish, 37 ask-side prints — anchor tape
INTC: $19M premium, 94% bullish, 40 ask-side prints — unusually clean directional skew
MRVL: $16.7M premium, 87% bullish, 55 ask-side prints — highest print count in scan
SNDK: $20.6M premium but only 59% bullish — size without conviction, watch carefully
AMD: $42M premium leaning 68% BEARISH — direct contradiction to the semi bull thesis
narrative.absences: No meaningful bullish flow in financials, industrials, healthcare, energy, or consumer despite broad Industry Layer qualification — this is a single-sector tape. Solar names (ENPH, FSLR, RUN) skew bearish or thin, undermining the clean-energy angle within XLK.
